Description: Full credit score calculation — KYC, land, financials, social impact metrics.
Criticality Reason: Core scoring engine. Multi-step: validate eligibility → populate DTO (NIDA + CRB + ESRI + simulation + account balance) → calculate 4 metric categories → risk assessment → store result.
Important Log Fields: application_id, credit_score_id, total_score, risk_level, recommended, simulation_id, duration_ms
Sensitive Data: Yes — national ID, account balance, CRB data, financial data
Dependencies: Access Control Service (NIDA validation, CRB risk score, ESRI land data), Application Service (account balance decryption), PostgreSQL (Events, CreditScoreCalculation, ScoreDictionary reads + writes)
Existing Observability: LoggerService with step-by-step logging in CreditScoreService.calculate
Observability Gap: No structured logging. No domain events. No metrics. No tracing. Errors caught and returned as 200 with error statusCode (anti-pattern). Account balance logged in plaintext.
Notes: Most complex endpoint. 5+ external API calls per request. Errors swallowed and returned as success with error statusCode. console.log('Error', error) in getAccountBalance.
